main_body: Mansard slate roof over a three-storey brick facade with a striped awning shopfront
top_band: Teal-grey roof band, rows 17-23 (L 95-122), closed by a dark line at row 24, then textured slate slope rows 25-43 above an orange cornice at row 44
evidence: The roof is a textured slate slope with a lighter top band at rows 17-23, and the dormers sit on it. A dark line at row 24 and the dark rows 41-43 above the orange cornice (row 44) mark the front edge and eave shadow. The brick facade below is a flat front face, but its windows have stone frames and sills, so they read as inset. The roof band is borderline, but the roof slope and cornice are distinct enough to read as a building with a roof surface.

style.evidence: The candidate carries 14 colours per tile against 18 and 11 for the references, and has only 2% flat fill, so it is rich in texture and detail (slate scallops, brick variation, lit windows). 97% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, against 7-9% for the references. The outline is therefore a near-black sticker line (#1d1722) rather than a dark tone of the adjacent material. That is the shallow outline look, so it fails despite the good density.
